symptom: A documented `~/.mxcli/mxbuild/*/modeler/mx check app.mpr` fails with `Verb '/root/.mxcli/mxbuild/<other>/modeler/mx' is not recognized`, and it looks like a broken mxbuild install
cause: The shell expands the `*` to every cached version and `mx` reads the second path as an argument. Both binaries are fine; it is purely the command line, and the failure mode is misleading enough that an earlier report recorded the wrong binary as broken
file: `cmd/mxcli/init_claudemd.go` (the generated project docs), plus ~15 `.md` files including three SYNCED skills (`manage-security`, `custom-widgets`, `alter-page`)
insight: **Document `mxcli docker check -p <app>.mpr` first** — it resolves the version from the project, which is the whole problem. Where `mx` must be called directly, name a version (`<version>`), never glob. Note the split: `filepath.Glob` in Go (`cmd/mxcli/docker/detect.go`) is CORRECT and must not be "fixed" — it globs then picks, whereas a shell passes all matches through. This reaches every user, since anyone who has used two Mendix versions has two cached. ako/mxcli-maintenance-2
